Let generalized flows $({\mathcal M}_n,G_n)$ converge geometrically on $U_n\times [0,\theta )$, $0<\theta <1$, to the standard solution. For large $n$, every point of the image lies in a $(C'(\epsilon ),\epsilon )$-cap, is the center of a strong $\epsilon $-neck, or is the center of an evolving $\epsilon $-neck with initial time $0$.

\label{stdsolnlimit}

Let generalized flows $({\mathcal M}_n,G_n)$ converge geometrically on
$U_n\times[0,\theta)$, $0<\theta<1$, to the standard solution. For large
$n$, every point of the image lies in a $(C'(\epsilon),\epsilon)$-cap,
is the center of a strong $\epsilon$-neck, or is the center of an evolving
$\epsilon$-neck with initial time $0$.
\end{corollary}
